releaseNotes: Implement backup and device management features
changelog: Add BackupModels for handling backup data structures.
Introduce DeviceIdentity for generating and storing unique device IDs.
Create DevicesScreen for displaying connected devices with options to remove them.
Implement DataBackup for exporting and importing user data securely.
Add unit tests for backup functionality to ensure data integrity and security.
Update UI components to reflect new features and improve user experience.
Integrate haptic feedback for various user interactions.
Refactor settings to move user logout functionality to a dedicated AccountScreen.
